blocks.text: Every hit burns through shields, then armor, then hull, and each weapon is better against a different one.
blocks.title: Break through, layer by layer

blocks.text: A Shipyard builds warships as specialists that each hunt one kind of target.
blocks.title: specialist variants

blocks.text: Drones, tractor beams, missile salvos, flak, rail guns: each class can fight its own way.
blocks.title: weapon Mods

blocks.text: Radiation zones, spice nebulae, ion storms and twin suns shape every battlefield.
blocks.title: Living star systems

blocks.text: Grow your pops, dig your worlds' crusts dry, and watch a drained gas giant blow.
blocks.title: Worlds worth fighting for

blocks.text: AI or NAI, it plays your rules and sees only what its sensors see.
blocks.title: An opponent that never cheats

blocks.text: Mine, haul, build, attack, take worlds. Your worlds feed and power it all.
Research what your strategy needs, and strike before the enemy outgrows you.
Ships inside a spice nebula stay hidden unless an enemy is close; a seen enemy starbase stays on your map.
Nothing refills. Rocks, gas giants, worlds' crusts and spice nebulae all run out, so a long match becomes a fight over what is left.
Destroy every enemy starbase and Constructor, or starve them into a Terminal Blackout. Losing every world does not end the game.
